title: Governance Viewer is a lens, not a source of law
issue_presented: May the Atlas Governance V2 human Viewer constitute a second current-law authority, pointer, or competing branch of Governance?

known_facts.fact: User Order of 2026-08-23 requires a CourtListener-style Viewer inside private Atlas-Governance-V2, reading canonical artifacts and rendering PDFs.
Universal current law is resolved through ATLAS_RECORD → CURRENT_LAW.md → Atlas-Governance-V2 SHA (J-0010).

analysis: A permanent Viewer branch, a Viewer-owned current-law pointer, or copied authoritative artifacts inside viewer/ would recreate competing-authority. The Viewer must share the same SHA as the canonical record after merge.
judgment_rule: The Governance Viewer lives in Atlas-Governance-V2/viewer/ and is a human lens over canonical artifacts. It is not a second Governance authority.
Canonical Judgments, Orders, Arguments, Findings, Jobs, and current-law records remain outside viewer/. The Viewer must not store independent authoritative copies of their substance.

The Viewer must resolve current law only through ATLAS_RECORD → CURRENT_LAW.md. Failure is UNKNOWN or USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. No silent fallback to cache, historical Governance, or another branch.
A generated PDF is a rendition. Filed PDFs are preserved and must not be silently regenerated to reflect later substantive changes; a later change is a new filing.
The Viewer endpoint is read-only as to canonical Governance state.
Viewer development may occur on a temporary branch. After validation it must be merged into the authoritative Governance branch. It must not remain a permanent parallel Governance branch.
A current Governance SHA represents both the canonical record and the Viewer code capable of rendering that record.
Plain-English caption PDFs are reading aids. They use the same docket numbers as the clerk index. They are not a second docket, not a Judgment, and not a source of law.
operational_effect: AI docket at / (INDEX.json) is the record. My docket at /human is rebuilt from that record on each load. Caption PDF or full filed PDF. Agents continue to begin at ATLAS_RECORD, not at the Viewer.
exceptions: Watcher overlay, Atlas Law Viewer, trading, Hunter, and Math are unchanged by this Judgment.
required_validation: validation/VIEWER_VALIDATION.json tests A–K PASS; merge into main; ATLAS_RECORD SHA includes viewer/.
